_comment: Cases for the rule that decides when today stops being provisional, and
what an unfinished day is allowed to do to the balance.
The rule: with nothing running, a gap of more than an hour outside normal
work hours means the day is done. Until it is done, the day can only add
a surplus to the balance, never subtract a shortfall.
It exists twice — in lib/domain/day_settlement.dart and, so the launcher
tile cannot disagree with the screen, in the widget's Kotlin. Both are
The window is 08:00-18:00 (480-1080) unless a case says otherwise. Times
are minutes since midnight; idle gaps are in seconds.
Only the same-day judgement is shared. The Dart original also settles any
day the calendar has moved past, which the widget can never be asked.

cases.name: a running session means the day is not over
nothing logged yet is not a finished day
a long lunch inside work hours is not the end of the day
an hour idle after work hours ends the day
a short gap after work hours does not
exactly one hour is not yet more than an hour
the last minute of the window still counts as inside it
an early finish before the window opens settles too

contributionCases.name: an unfinished day adds a surplus immediately
a finished day counts its shortfall
a finished day counts its surplus
